name: Maria Teresa Del Rio
office: City of Hawaiian Gardens, Member of the City Council

items.text: Maria Teresa Del Rio is a member of the Hawaiian Gardens City Council and has served as mayor. She earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Cal State University, Fullerton. She works as a project manager for an outpatient treatment program that provides rehabilitation for substance abuse and addiction. In February 2026, the City Council adopted an ordinance setting size limits of 850 to 1,000 square feet and requiring one off-street parking space per accessory dwelling unit or bedroom, whichever is less; Del Rio was mayor when the ordinance passed.
